rule: An active (EFF, ADC, EXP) individual (NPD, SIN) NPDES permit that is a sewage permit (SIC 4952 or NAICS 221320 among its codes, or the POTW permit component; not stormwater-only) and whose permittee is not a public body: EPA's facility type Privately Owned Facility, Corporation or Non-Government with names that do not read as a public body, or a mixed, blank or unknown type with names that read as a private body.
privacy: No address, ZIP or coordinate is copied. A facility or permittee name is kept only when it reads as a body; any other, and every name of a single-residence system, is "[name removed]" with the permit kept. The permittee of record is taken from the state's permit documents, never an individual's name.
for_the_builder: Candidates for operator rows (data/dischargers.json), one per permittee: confirm the permittee and its legal form from the state's permit documents (legal_form_proposed is a hint from the names), group permits of one permittee, and file the register rows the state's law gives private operators. A permit in public_by_name is typed private by EPA but reads as a public body: check it before filing. registry_row or research_row set means the permit is already held.
